## Overview

The **Lines** page in the Media Viewer properties panel controls styling and specialized line workflows such as **Draw Across All Frames**.

## Creating and Editing Lines

Use the **Pen** tool on the left toolbar for single-frame line work:

1. Enable a `LineData` key in the feature table so it appears in the Pen tool **Pen target** list.
2. Activate the **Pen** tool.
3. To start a new line on the current frame, choose **New line · {your key}** and click on the canvas. The first click creates the line and selects it; further **Ctrl+click** gestures append vertices.
4. To extend an existing line, choose **Selected line**, select the line with the **Select** tool (or keep the selection from a just-created line), then **Ctrl+click** to append.

Use **Append to** in the Pen options bar to control whether new vertices attach at the tip, base, or nearest endpoint.

For batch placement across many frames, use **Draw Across All Frames** in the line properties panel.

See also: [Toolbar](tools.qmd)
